label: pjm 161 event-cap
definition: pjm-161 TREATMENT (PROBE — REJECTED): pjm-152 keeper recipe with pjm_measured_outage_event_cap armed, single delta vs pjm161_ctl_A. A REMOVE-ONLY, TOTAL-outage-basis availability cap on PJM's own published gen_outages_by_type record (the ERCOT-148/149 event-cap shape, pjm-145's own named re-open route 3), zero fitted parameters. Motivated by the pjm-161 Phase-0 finding that the CAMPD outage envelope is ANTI-CORRELATED with scarcity in every year (corr -0.68..-0.77; during Winter Storm Elliott it asserts its LOWEST derate of 2022, 15.6 GW, against PJM's published 31-41 GW). REFUTED BY ITS OWN PRE-REGISTERED PREDICTIONS: P1 liveness and P2 no-resurrection pass (max availability delta exactly 0.0) and P5 CC_REGULAR falls in all three years, but P4 FAILS OUTRIGHT (C3c hours>$200 3/10/32 UNCHANGED, max price identical) and P6's top-1%-net-load unavailable MW is unchanged -- the cap adds ~zero outage in the hours it was built for, because PJM's published TOTAL is dominated by planned outages scheduled away from peaks. No gate regresses (C1 16/16 free 12/12; NOT-YET only on C6 UNATTESTED) and several class errors improve, but the mechanism failed its own targeting test, so it is NOT promoted (rule 1). Keeper unchanged at 2026-08-04-pjm-152-collapse. FINDING-pjm161-outage-inversion-and-da-virtual-energy-2026-08-14.md section 7.
